answer: Persistent Work Ledger. Each identity must accumulate a pigment score of verified task-hours before its votes or transactions carry weight; score decays on a fixed half-life, so idle fakes erode. New identities start at zero and climb a spiral of escalating task difficulty—cheap early tasks yield negligible score, only costly onyx-tier work raises it. An attacker cloning N agents must fund N parallel work histories continuously; cost scales with N times decay rate, not a one-time toll.
